headline: Public hearing on new construction at 43 St. Lawrence Street, and review of the National Register nomination for Harvey Gamage.
summary: The meeting includes a public hearing on a new construction project at 43 St. Lawrence Street. It also covers a recommendation on the National Register nomination for Harvey Gamage and the 2027 filing deadlines and meeting dates.
items: Report on October 21, 2026 public hearing: National Register nomination for Harvey Gamage (Docked at 100 W. Commercial Street)
Report on October 21, 2026 workshop: Review of New Construction at 101 & 105 Winter Street, Plan Number HP-00123-2026
Report of decision: Board voted 5 in favor, none opposed, to recommend that the Maine Historic Preservation Commission support the National Register nomination for Harvey Gamage

to recommend that the Maine Historic Preservation Commission support the nomination.
